description: A new version and Remaster of NotEnoughFakepixel

releases.notes: This update 1.2.5 has a new config saving system to ensure the data is saved, Garden features for the new Fakepixel update and couple fixes and mayor detection

This update is mainly focused on Fakepixel Rebrand compatibility and NEF dettach from fork.

+ Added Crystal hollows keys to config
+ Added Accessories list scroll keys to config
+ Etherwarp Zoom
+ Superpairs Solvers
+ Jerry Island Gifts Waypoints
+ Prevent salvaging Mythic items
- Fixed Crystal Hollows edit map position misplace
- Fixed Accessories data crashing when no data loaded
- Fixed crash checking for Season
- Fixed Server crash checking for accessories in /viewprofile
- Deleted My Little farm features due to deletion of mode

Prevent Salvaging Mythic items
Fixing crash on misconfigured Wardrobe keys
Gift Waypoints on Jerry island

Fixed Chat spam on preventing Accessory crash
Added Superpairs Solvers
Added Etherwarp Zoom
